verdict.rationale: Klaviyo publishes a per-endpoint API reference (e.g. create_campaign, create_event). Runnable examples come through a Postman collection of pre-built requests, and you can explore the API in a test account populated with sample data. That makes examples runnable, but via an external tool rather than evidenced in-page interactivity. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser 'try it' console in the reference itself, documented code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
